decisions.reason: As an integrated automation product closely related to the firm's machinery and robotics knowledge base, it is more likely to be improved through learning than withdrawn quickly.

Although it overlaps with the combined robot and therefore faces some portfolio rationalisation risk, it still fits the firm's core capabilities and can serve customers wanting a specialised solution.
A profile storage robot is adjacent to the firm's established automation competences, so the firm is likely to retain it while using early market feedback to refine the offering.
Like the de-shuttering robot, it is technologically close to the firm's existing knowledge but has some risk of being consolidated if the combined system proves commercially stronger.
